hero.title: Let's Start with a Conversation
hero.subtitle: Your healthcare journey starts with a conversation.
hero.description: You do not need to have all the answers before contacting us. Tell us what you are looking for, tell us about your medical condition, and share your medical reports if you have them. Our team will help you understand the next step.

contactInfo.title: Get in Touch
contactInfo.description: Our patient coordinators are here to guide you through every step of your medical journey. Whether you need a specialist opinion, hospital coordination, or treatment planning, we're ready to help.
